description: aviowiki provides airport and aviation information in a machine-readable format, free to consult online and through a professional API. The company says an in-house data team with aviation industry experience manually verifies sources and data, applies strict quality control and builds new data, not copying and rebranding public sources, so that users can automate processes; it also offers a free access aviation data hub as an example use. Coverage: global airports and aviation data as described on the homepage. Format and access: a website and an API; professional API use needs an account. Licence and cost: freemium, with commercial terms for the API; prices are not given on the homepage. Caveats: the homepage is marketing text and gives no field list, record counts or update frequency, which must be checked with the provider. It supplies airport reference data for network flow and capacity planning models of air transport. It relates to OurAirports and the ICAO API data service in the catalogue as a curated alternative.
licence: Commercial terms for the API; free online consultation
